scope: Hays County Poaceae – 58 iNaturalist candidate names
criteria: Existing 112 preserved; POWO preferred for current taxonomy; GBIF exact species usage keys and user-provided 1999 Flora for independent cross-check; no fuzzy GBIF names adopted.
limits: This adjudicates names/species concepts for staging only; any Hays iNaturalist ID can be wrong or planted.
Some GBIF exact accepted names have not had an independent Kew species detail page inspected; such rows include GBIF + Flora references and no false Kew URL.
Selected historical aliases are relevant search/display names, not an exhaustive synonym catalog.
The 1999 Flora is a regional key and its broader species concepts can disagree with POWO, especially Bothriochloa longipaniculata.
No species, photos, indexes or IDs are written to the public ID Lab.
Nativity/BONAP NAPA and visual ID checks remain separate.

citation_audit.note: POWO pages are sources for Kew accepted names where available; Alopecurus carolinianus independently supported by WCVP World Flora Online, USDA GRIN and ITIS.

synonymy_scope: Curated searchable historical aliases / commonly used combinations relevant to Texas Floras; not exhaustive global homotypic/heterotypic synonymy.

name_review_framework.historical: Flora of North Central Texas (1999), exact names and explicitly documented combinations
name_review_framework.secondary: GBIF acceptedUsageKey (full 58 versus 112 audit), USDA GRIN/ITIS/World Flora Online for exceptions
name_review_framework.recheck_trigger: New relevant taxonomic publication, newer POWO change, or identification evidence contradicting the current species concept.
